mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals a weak labor market that may prompt central bank intervention or reduced corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate slower economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative feedback loop in the economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior 3-month levels, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession recovery phase, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 indicates a slowdown in manufacturing activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy struggles to regain momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 during post-recession recovery, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal in this regime is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation that may lead the central bank to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 per month indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion, a decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized rate signals weak economic momentum, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy fails to gain traction.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 1.0% during early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC for the GDPC1 signal in this regime is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 from its prior 3-month average signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO signal is below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
